p1_findings.title: canonical frontier identity omits output block despite per-block descriptor replay
p1_findings.impact: Block-outer replay can let the completed frontier of an earlier output block early-close later blocks; source-outer replay instead needs a charged all-block acceptance barrier and very different weight-refill behavior. The future analyzer can currently choose either behavior.
p1_findings.required_fix: Freeze one replay order. Prefer adding output_block to frontier token, owner, close key and monotonicity rule for block-outer processing; alternatively define and charge an all-output-block atomic replay barrier. Add a two-output-block early-close negative reference.

p1_findings.title: the claimed dense-shape zero-token protocol is not a frozen or charged interface
p1_findings.impact: Never-existed destinations can be modeled with free output completion even though no frozen input defines token width, handshake, cycle, byte, sink backpressure or reconstruction state; this changes exact output semantics and the common-cycle denominator.
p1_findings.required_fix: Either send a charged padded zero vector or freeze an exact zero-token plus sink protocol and charge all state, cycles, bytes and backpressure identically to all four architecture points.

p2_findings.finding: The 239636-byte result is a logical modeled-memory closure, not foundry macro closure; actual width/depth banking and especially 1R1W tag implementation remain for the paired physical gate.

PSUM_SCRATCH_BASE remains symbolic. A future contract should freeze at least 128-byte alignment, the 42393600-byte non-aliased reserved window and non-overlap with weight/output windows before any DRAM mapping or energy claim.
Rename source_sign_encoding.one_is_malformed to source_sign_bit_one_is_malformed so a JSON consumer cannot confuse the malformed sign bit with the required numeric source value one.

required_r4_closure: freeze output-block replay order and complete frontier identity or all-block barrier

freeze and charge exact zero output transport or always emit a charged dense zero vector
label current SRAM organizations as modeled rather than foundry-macro closed
